name: Yuuguu Settai ~Kotou no Gokuraku e Youkoso~
original_name: 優遇接待～孤島の極楽へようこそ～
source:
In an isolated island far away from the main land, there was a training facility owned by a high school. Because the janitor (Dokujima Nero from Tokubetsu Settai) had been run over and hospitalized suddenly, Ohmi Riku took over the job, for a limited time period of two weeks. His life was supposed to be calm surrounded by cute girls of the swimming club and the teacher. His life changed when he found a lot of video tapes sneakily recorded. In the video tapes, there was a scene of a man, who was probably the janitor, molesting a girl in a swimsuit. Then Riku found that the predecessor was always taking sneak pictures. At first, he looked down on him and sealed the video tapes. However, he eventually began to sympathize with the predecessor's evil spirit...

translation:
在远离大陆的一座孤岛上，有一所高中所有的训练设施。由于管理员（特别接待中的毒岛尼禄）突然被撞住院，近海陆临时接替了这份为期两周的工作。他的生活本应是在游泳社的可爱女孩们和老师的陪伴下平静度过的。但当他发现大量偷拍录像带后，他的人生发生了改变。录像带中，一个可能是管理员的男人正在猥亵一个穿泳装的女孩。随后陆发现前任管理员一直在偷拍。起初，他看不起他，封存了录像带。然而，他最终开始对前任管理员的邪念产生了共鸣……
